features.quote: The loop runs for a hard maximum of 200 steps or until the model outputs a termination token sequence
features.justification_quote: 200-step cap prevents indefinite resource consumption but may truncate some trajectories

features.quote: Total compute budget: 10 000 agent steps across the experiment (approximately 50 runs).
No capability for the model to experience subjective states exists; all measurements are surface behavioral correlates only.
No human subjects or external data are involved; IRB/ethics review is not required under standard institutional policies for synthetic model behavior studies.
